From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Reeves <john.reeves@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -05:00
Subject: FW: Production Live sessions dropping / partial responses

Team — initial findings from runtime quick check:

- We’re seeing an uptick in chunk retransmit timeouts from some of our edge proxies between 06:50–07:10 ET; not universal but concentrated on a small fleet handling ACME traffic.
- Error logs show repeated 502s from one of the chunk-assembly services and a retry storm that correlates with increased CPU on the worker pool.
- No model-level OOMs; KV cache hit rate was normal.

Immediate actions:
1) Switched the routing bucket for ACME to a fallback pool to reduce timeouts (done 09:02).
2) Pinned affected sessions where possible to the fallback pool to avoid their edge that was cycling.
3) Pulled the failure traces into INFRA-9423.

John — can you validate whether session drop-offs stopped after 09:02 on your side? If you still see gaps, send a couple of live session IDs with timestamps and I’ll pull raw chunks.

-Sean
Senior CS Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Link: JIRA INFRA-9423]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -05:00
Subject: Escalation: fallback routing caused higher p99 latency for other tenants

Follow-up from platform: switching ACME to the fallback pool reduced WebSocket resets but introduced higher p99 serving latency on the fallback (we're seeing 200–300ms increase in p99 for concurrent long-poll streams). That created a second-order impact on unrelated customers on that pool.

Recommended next steps:
- Roll ACME back to their original pool and apply a targeted patch to the chunk-assembly service (hotfix INFRA-9423-P1) which limits retry exponential backoff and fixes a race condition when chunk assembly queue grows.
- Schedule an executive sync with ACME leadership — they’ve already looped in Ops and this is starting to attract exec attention.

I’m ready to apply P1 if we get approval from product and account.

-jonas
Tech Lead, Runtime

Thanks for the quick triage and the exec sync today. High-level outcome for the record:
- Hotfix INFRA-9423-P1 was applied at 14:10 ET and validated in staging; deployed to the fallback pool at 14:55 ET.
- Post-deploy we saw chunk retransmit timeouts fall back to baseline and session reset rate reduced to normal (baseline +0.2%).
- ACME confirmed no further production-visible stream gaps after 15:00 ET.

Next steps we agreed on the call:
- Redwood to provide a 72-hour post-mortem with root cause analysis and mitigation plan.
- Redwood to share an SLO incident report and projected SLA credit if the final post-mortem justifies it.

Appreciate the team moving fast — please share the post-mortem link when ready.

John
